findings.evidence: Step 0 packs triage, the top-10 cap, the batching message and a search exemption into one paragraph: 'Cutting the list never cuts the search: every name you report still gets the repo and string-literal search of step 1, except an identifier whose definition and uses show it is a lexical local ... members, exported names and anything unproven get the full search.'
findings.fix: Split step 0 into short sub-bullets: (a) rank by the Decide table order and report at most 10; (b) say how many candidates are not shown; (c) search rule: lexical locals get a scope-local search, and every other reported name gets the full symbol and string-literal search. Keep every rule.

findings.evidence: '## What not to flag or suggest' (and the issue list in '## What to look for') has no loading trigger. The gating list at SKILL.md:31 names only Priority classes, Boolean names, Acceptable abbreviations, Convention fallback tree and Convention splits. Step 1 points only at the Convention layers paragraph.
findings.fix: Add to the gating sentence in SKILL.md step 2: 'What not to flag or suggest before you propose a vague-name, single-letter or class-suffix rename'. Name What to look for as the place to read the issue list when the user asks for a broad review.

findings.evidence: 'Format this Python file with black and sort the imports.' shares no intent with naming review, so this negative tests nothing. The same goes for the camelCase-vs-snake_case explainer at the end.
findings.fix: Replace it with a near-miss such as 'Add type hints and docstrings to the functions in billing.py so reviewers understand what they return', which overlaps with clarity but is not a naming review.

findings.evidence: Step 3 goes straight from rating to 'report and end with the counts line'. There is no self-check that each row cites its evidence line, has both scale values, and that hidden or contract rows propose an alias, not a plain rename.
findings.fix: Add before reporting: 'Check each row: evidence cites a line or caller; confidence and compatibility are set; every hidden or contract row keeps the external name and proposes an alias or migration; each tentative row carries its settling question. Fix any row that fails, then report.'
